design_philosophy: Awwwards-level minimal & editorial design for a luxury real estate land developer. Focus on spaciousness, high-quality visuals, trust-building via typography, and smooth kinetic motion to elevate the plotting experience.

typography.pairing_strategy: Tiro Devanagari provides an elegant, rooted, and trustworthy feel for Devanagari and English headings. Outfit offers high geometric legibility for body text, numbers, and badges.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 for section padding.
layout.grid_system: Bento grids for projects and asymmetrical split-panels for detail pages.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating headers (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Minimal borders (border-black/5). DO NOT use fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows for cards. No harsh drops.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Subtle grain textures, noise overlays. Slow-moving marquees for project USPs.

motion.reveals: Framer motion line-by-line text reveals on load.
motion.interactions: Hover states on project cards: scale image up slightly (scale-105) and reveal extra detail overlay.

components.hero: Kinetic hero with aerial plot image. Dark overlay bg-black/30. Line-by-line reveal of main tagline. Primary CTA.
components.navbar: Glassmorphism yellow-tab (or yellow accented) navbar. Links: Home, Projects, About us, Contact us. Sticky top with z-50.
components.projects_grid: 10 Township Projects. Asymmetrical grid (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3). Image top, Marathi title, subtle hover effects.
components.project_detail: Split-panel: Sticky left gallery/images, right scrollable content. Badges: 'फक्त 649/- SQ.FT पासून चालू', 'N.A PLOT', 'प्लॉट घेणेस कर्ज उपलब्ध'. Features list, Map, Download Brochure button.
components.contact: Office address, phone, Google Maps embed. Inquiry form capturing name, phone, email, project, message.
components.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right green WhatsApp button with 'I need help?' tooltip.
components.marquee: Slow editorial marquee outlining 'Why Choose Us / Our Manifesto'.

hero_aerial.description: Aerial view of green township plots

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React and Tailwind CSS. Create the UI in JS, not TS.
Implement 'Pandurang Land Developers' with Marathi and English text support. Use Google Font 'Tiro Devanagari Marathi' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for body text.
Create these pages/views: Home, Projects, About us, Contact us. Set up routing (e.g. react-router-dom) to navigate.

Ensure exactly 10 projects are listed with Marathi names: लक्ष्मीनारायण पार्क, व्यंकटेश पार्क, संत बाळूमामा पार्क, सिद्धेश्वर पार्क, मंगलमूर्ती पार्क, ब्राह्मनाथ पार्क, रामचंद्र पार्क, श्री हरी पार्क, श्री राम पार्क, मोरया पार्क.

Projects Detail Page must include feature bullets in Marathi/English, pricing badge ('फक्त 649/- SQ.FT पासून चालू'), 'N.A PLOT' badge, 'प्लॉट घेणेस कर्ज उपलब्ध' badge, Google maps embed, and download brochure button.
Add a fixed floating WhatsApp button at the bottom right corner with a tooltip 'I need help?'.
Inquiry form on the Contact page should have fields: Name, Phone, Email, Project Interested, Message. Add logic to handle submission (can be a mock API call but show success state).
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals, text reveals, and micro-interactions.
Ensure responsive design. Follow mobile-first approach.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Use the provided image URLs to populate the hero, project cards, and about sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
